title: Change-aware CI test selection
problem: Selecting blocking test suites based on changed code, including test flakiness concerns.
statement: A developer proposes using an LLM to select relevant blocking CI tests and estimate how often new complex tests should run.
source_context_date: 2026-01 (approximate; discussion marked 10 months old as of 2026-11-03)
limitations: One public comment does not establish prevalence or willingness to pay.
Need benchmark against existing selective-test solutions.
questions: How often do teams overspend time on unnecessary tests?
Which CI vendors already offer test-impact analysis?
